_doc: Headwaters source registry - Chennai episodic sources. Schema + design notes: docs/specs/headwaters.md (local). Validate: npm run data:check. Baseline/accept: scripts/check-upstream-editions.ts --accept <id>.

sources.notes: NWMP annual River Water Quality listing; year pages (e.g. nwmp-data-2) appear as new links, typically Jan-Mar. Serves Chennai (4 rivers/10 stations), Bengaluru (Vrishabhavathi/Arkavathy/Dakshina Pinakini), Madurai (Vaigai 10059/10060). Host has broken TLS and was fully unreachable on 2026-07-21 even with curl -k from a residential IP - check-failures expected until CPCB recovers; retry before changing this entry.

sources.notes: 17th TN Assembly: polled 2026-04-23, results 2026-05-04, TVK won 108 seats. The 2026 refresh landed 2026-07-25, roughly 12 weeks late, because nothing watched the term - that gap is why term-expiry exists. The same election also restaffs Madurai's MLAs if that city ever gets representative data. Tamil names outstanding (good-first-issue).

sources.notes: Council elected 2022-02-19, councillors sworn in 2022-03-04, nominal 5-year term. This is the big one: 200 rows change at once, hence the deliberate 90-day lead. Phone numbers are only published in the GCC council PDF and lag the result by weeks.

sources.notes: 18th Lok Sabha first sat 2024-06-24. Verified unchanged on 2026-07-25 (no Chennai by-election; no sitting MP won an assembly seat in 2026). A mid-term by-election will NOT trip this check - term-expiry is a calendar, not a news feed.
